notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions 🥁
notes.content:
Although Ragnarock has no more secrets for most of you Vikings, there are still a few raiders out there seeking guidance to master the beat. We figured there was no better way to start the year than by gathering the most frequently asked questions into one dedicated article. Whether you're a new challenger or a hammer-wielding veteran, this FAQ has got you covered!

1️⃣Can I play Ragnarock without VR?
Absolutely! The game has been available on PC since 2023. So grab a controller or a keyboard and drum your way through the rocking playlist curated with love.

2️⃣Can we play in a local multiplayer mode?
Yes, there is a split screen mode available in the Steam PC version. Get comfortably seated in your living room with your friends and compete against up to 3 of them. Note that VR players won’t be able to join.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/07227d7776a7a74614d1f197c5b5157ad0406bf3.png

3️⃣In online multiplayer, are we playing against VR and PC players?
In online multiplayer, you are playing against both types of players by default. You can choose to play only against players from your platform by going to the Advanced Settings and selecting whichever option feels better to you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/baff1f747c7240080ac14c03c81bc3477737567e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/ecb7b3f82298c5f6f8288e5bd225a3797b8184a3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/4683721ac37a050b940773d9aa48ca36a9a8b7d1.png

4️⃣What can I do to improve my scoring?
 Add beat lines to help you keep up with the tempo by going to the Settings right before a song starts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/ed519f8fe08edf3ae9b8ec602215f24f95c06a5d.png

 Change your rune speed to your liking so you can anticipate more easily what’s coming. This setting is right below the Display beat lines one and can be changed from one song to the other.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/7110e9051c312cb24e96fd6554e36ea70175dbb2.png

 Turning down Drum sound compensation in the Advanced Settings. This will allow you to hear exactly when you hit the drum, rather than the corrected, more in sync, drum sound. This can help you realize whether you hit too early/too late.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/4d871c971b957bce297fe857bc07faee4a321628.png

You can find more tips on how to improve your scoring here.


5️⃣VR Only : Can I change the drums’ position?
Yes, you can choose to place the drums in an arc position if you feel like it would help you aim for the runes more easily. Go to the Advanced Settings to enable the option and then place the drums however you want by going to the Display setting right before a song starts.

6️⃣Can I turn off the vikings in my boats?
Yes, in the Audio settings just lower the voice to 0 and you’ll have a quiet ride !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/30d12ca0d4cb0932b42dc7e7f284ba77f0fdc5c5.png

7️⃣Are the DLC available offline?
Only the base game and its 46 songs are available to play offline.

8️⃣How many songs are available in the game?
46 songs are available in the base game.
38 more are part of Raids (DLC) so that makes 84 songs in total.

You can find the links to the DLCs here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/abe138b6b9f07f035eb68e267f21bb97e6082312.png


You can find more questions about the game in general here.


If you still have questions or if some of those answers aren't helpful enough, don't hesitate to write us either here, on our Discord, or by email at contact@wanadevstudio.com.

Keep rocking on !

Collaborate with your teammates on different missions with varying difficulty levels, and objectives that can change depending on the map and the creature.

TRACK
Examine the evidence found on the ship to identify the creature you're facing and figure out how to eliminate it. Solve puzzles and find the weapon that will help you during the boss fight.

SURVIVE
Survive at all costs. Use the environment to your advantage and make use of tools like the motion detector, shield, or mini-map to navigate the ship without getting killed. Adopt the right group strategy to eradicate or capture the creatures.

REPEAT
Expand your list of kills and earn credits that you can use to customize your equipment, allowing you to face the fiercest creatures.

notes.title: Ask me Anything - Ragnarock x Gloryhammer RAID
notes.content:
Last week, we invited you to ask all your questions to answer them in this Ask me Anything about this Ragnarock x Gloryhammer RAID. 


We received a lot of questions. In particular this one : How many maps and what price?
Don’t worry, we'll answer them at the end of this article! 

So let's jump in! 

[olist]
A RAID is just a song/cosmetic pack or there are gameplay elements too? like an adventure in some form or another.

RAIDs are packs including new sounds and cosmetics. They are bringing with them new FREE features for everyone. 


Im looking everywhere for the song list of the new RAID content! Where can I find them? 

We know that these songs are really important for you, that’s why we want to give you more information about that tomorrow! 



How was the breakfast ?

Really hard to digest... But we’re ready for Thursday! (For those who do not have the reference, we invite you to see this video : youtu.be/RSBI_j7YSPA


Does he have the map tattooed on his back? 

I don't dare ask him... He looked at me meanly while eating coffee beans… :D 
Otherwise no kidding, I don't think so (well, I hope not...). By the way, feel free to follow him on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cadu_drums/


Is there any chance the Quest 2 version will get patched to run at 90Hz?

This is one of our current objectives, we are working on it!


Any news about a possible SDK? to mod the game or interface it with funny stuff?

We’re adding an API to send custom song scores to a url. We’ll give you more possibilities step by step. 


Have you thought about haptic systems for Ragnarock?

Haptic system already work on Ragnarock (and PropagationVR), if you want more information, you can check this video : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MR9CSUgXTqE&ab_channel=bHaptics) 


What’s the team's favorite song for the dlc?

The Fires of Ancient Cosmic Destiny! Because mapping a 12 mn song is a real challenge. On the other hand it will be a real challenge for you to finish it in difficulty 10 (You need strong shoulders! :D) 


And of course the most asked question : How many songs are we getting and how much is it?
 
With this first Ragnarock RAID, we are bringing you 6 new Gloryhammer songs! 
The Ragnarock x Gloryhammer bundle will be available for $5.99. 

[/olist]

We hope to have answered all your questions before the release of Ragnarock x Gloryhammer RAID.

notes.title: The Ragnarock V1 release is now available!
notes.content:
Ahoy fellow vikings!

Today is the day! After almost 7 months of Early Access, we’re very happy and proud to release the V1 version of Ragnarock, accompanied by a multitude of additional musical content, a new environment and awesome new features, which will continue to be extended over time.

[previewyoutube=qC5LeAVzDlM;full][/previewyoutube]

What you will find in the Muspelheim update

6 new epic tracks!

Because songs are the heart of this rhythm game, we are happy to announce the arrival of 6 new awesome tracks in addition to the previous 24!

To begin with, we are proud to announce a new collaboration with Alestorm, a pirate metal staple, with the arrival of "No grave but the sea" on the tracklist.

Because there is nothing better than a bit of crazy metal music, Ragnarock players will now be able to smash runes on Kammthaar  and Evier Metal by the ones we don't even introduce anymore: Ultra Vomit!

Saltatio Mortis, who has long been requested by the community, also joins the list of bands participating in Ragnarock. The German folk metal group is therefore arriving with two new tracks: Loki (obviously!) and Löwenherz!

Finally, because everyone loved sweating like never before on “The Great Pirate Bottle” by Sabordage, Ragnarock welcomes a new bespoke track by Sabordage, “Au Petit Matin”, has been added to the list of available songs!

A new environment: travel to Muspelheim!

Since the first environment (Midgard), we've always wanted to add immersive content inspired by Norse mythology. The most observant will have noticed a logic of continuity between the different playable maps, and of course, a correlation between tracks and environments.

Muspelheim thus joins this list of 6 different environments. Muspelheim is the world of fire, kingdom of the giant Surtr... and we wanted to do something awesome!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/8cc0817b0c4cc5bba724058d26a7498799862634.jpg
Muspelheim artwork

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/0c99b26b641ef979f0886a7f0bcb0cadd61f4aae.jpg
Muspelheim artwork

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/9e3458ef48fad64713a36080a972e267be597cb7.png

New features to discover, train, collect and have fun!

Achievements!

Unlock Achievements to get great rewards: new epic and playable hammer pairs will be added to your collection. You can now change hammers using the selector on the right in the tavern. Please note that the differences between hammers are only visual and do not affect gameplay. Collect them all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/118f39a96bdb785fb8c6a7f42707dd5eab68744f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/f23668462c45b2cfd5a9e95c504e67b8fb77bca5.png

A new Practice Mode to become the best!

Check the “Practice Mode” checkbox at the start of a song or in the Pause Menu (in Solo) to choose your speed and the sequence you want to practice! (Please note that when using Practice Mode, medals and high scores are not saved. Ghosts are also not available in Practice Mode.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/691545301b5cce695f6cb9887a9b14e9987a1a34.png

Communicate thanks to emojis!

At the start and end of a multiplayer race, you will find behind you a forge of emojis allowing you to share your emotions with other players in an easy and fun way!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/339db98e3515ad8878cfee074d3008ebcac3791e.png

... and a lot of new fixes and optimization stuff!


 Performance optimization
 Map preference is now also applied in multiplayer games
 Updated stats panel on leaderboards
 Friends Leaderboard now available at the end of a song
 [Fix] Blue combo could not be used right after being acquired
 Lower sound for medals breaking
 Better rounding on hit/miss percentages
 [Fix] Removed invisible buttons in custom song list when less than 3 difficulties present


What happened during Early Access

During these almost seven months of Early Access, Ragnarock has gone through a lot of improvements, heavily influenced by the players’ feedback and needs.


 from 16 to 30 songs
 from 1 to 6 environments
 new design for lobby and UI
 female characters
 new audio system + pause
 a lot of settings (audio, vibrations, advanced, hammer/drums/shields)
 revised scoring system
 multiplayer improvements (vote, join during a race, server list, emojis)
 leaderboards with detailed stats and friends
 multiple ghosts (from leaderboards or friends)
 achievements and collectible hammers
 practice mode


[previewyoutube=oy2pIx3wb0U;full][/previewyoutube]

That's it for today!

As usual, we are still hard at work so stay tuned. You are all invited to share reactions and areas of improvement here, or chat with the dev team on our Discord!

WanadevStudio's social accounts are also great spots to share your feelings with us. You're welcome to follow us on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram!

Vikings, we look forward to seeing you on the sea by our side. See you soon! :beer: 

We want to give a very big thank you to the community that followed us during Early Access, provided feedback, discussed with us on Discord, and helped shape Ragnarock into the game it is today. And welcome to everyone who will join us for the next steps! Get ready for more and more frenzied Viking races on epic rock / metal tracks.

AHOU!

Ahoy captains!

We just released an update! Thanks to everyone who gave us feedback, and as always we want to give a very warm thank you to our reactive community and especially to our beta-testers for their time and help! Here's what you will find in this update:


 Asgard, an Epic New Journey 
Hold on to your boat, you're about to take off and travel through the skies and onto the Bifrost until you reach the beautiful city of the gods: Asgard! We are very proud to bring you this new environment that will take you on a musical journey into the skies. Tell us in the comments what you think and try to guess which one is next!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/03dc268ad10f9fcbb1fbf421226fba02b946fa8d.jpg

 3 New Songs 
Masters of the Galaxy by Gloryhammer (level 3/5/9), Tortuga by Alestorm (level 3/5/7) and Welcome to Asgard by Manaberry (level 1/3/6), an original creation for Ragnaröck. Here are some more amazing songs to bang your drums to! Rest assured that we are working hard in order to keep adding more in the upcoming months.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/ed5a8e01c83677cbc2bc33dc2198df2a9ce61a2b.jpg

 Improved Leaderboards
- Display detailed stats of high scores when hovering the Leaderboard (in lobby)
- Additional Leaderboard with Steam friends only (in lobby)
- Blue and yellow combos counted separately on score panel and in stats
Please note to support these new features (and the new ghosts), Leaderboards, high scores and medals have been reset.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/50124810683669ea099a173cda26182377868e8c.jpg

 More Ghost Options
Five more ghosts are now available in solo (on top of your Personal best) on each song/level:
- Song Top #1 (from global leaderboard)
- Player ranked 10 places above you (from global leaderboard)
- Player ranked 5 places above you (from global leaderboard)
- Top #1 amongst your friends (from Friends leaderboard)
- Friend ranked above you (from Friends leaderboard)
You can choose which ghosts are activated and against which one your distance is compared (panel at the front of your boat) in the Ghost settings. Get ready for solo races with up to 6 real adversaries!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/2af2871bab4d9d4f79258a7a8f85eba4243798d2.jpg

 Improved Multiplayer
- [PvP Quickplay] Display list of available servers and their status: number of players, song playing, time remaining
- [PvP Quickplay] Public servers now have a difficulty range (displayed in the list). Songs and votes can only be chosen in this range.
- [PvP Quickplay] You can create a new server with your own difficulty range and choose the first song. You can play alone on a server while waiting for other players.
- [PvP Quickplay AND Private] Join the race mid-song even if it has already started (good luck catching up to the others!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/e4cac43087f03a987a7297fb5aa92cadefce5893.jpg

 Improved Quick Menu (during a song)
- In solo, opening the menu pauses the game (you can't pause a PvP race of course)
- Drums and hammers settings are now available in the Quick menu
- On Oculus headsets, you must now press the Menu button on the left controller to open the Quick menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/9512e34db4208882df798241f7c0ddfed097535a.jpg

 New Sound Engine
Better audio synchronization, using the fmod sound engine. This is intended to solve the sync problems between music and rune hits that some players told us about (and for which they used the latency setting to compensate). It also allows us to add cool new features now and in the future (like Pause).
Please note your previous latency settings are now obsolete. We advise you to reset the latency to zero before playing (see Advanced settings).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/345c8226156ebfc73e4cc12c6bb643f57e0094fd.png

 New “Advanced” Settings
- moved “Latency” setting there
- new setting to show latency in your score panel (disabled by default)
- new setting to adjust the “Drum sound compensation” (0% : Play the drum sound exactly when you hit (more accurate), 100% : Play the drum sound exactly on the beat (more ear-pleasing), Default: 70%)
- Setting “Skip intro” to bypass the logo/splash screens on startup
- Setting “Hide hands” to remove hand models on your hammers during game

- “Viewer cameras” can now be activated and chosen from this menu (multiple viewpoints available). This feature allows you to display external camera views on your monitor, independently from your VR view. It can be used to :

Provide a more comfortable viewing experience for spectators, either on your couch or during livestreams
Create entertaining gameplay videos with multiple camera angles and movements
Record yourself playing from a different point of view to improve your technique or give us specific feedback

Warning : Please note this feature may cause performance issues. If you had already activated external cameras using the Steam guide (now updated), please note your camera settings will be reset and you must activate them again through the in-game settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/18def3f07e5b327ee3450459838d32983da4e4c7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/67e755d7143019975fc383ff752dae153f2d0fef.jpg

 New “Empty” environment: Just the sea and you, nothing else in sight. Can be useful for performance issues or motion sickness problems.
 More stable ghost (accurate position, no jumps)
 Smoother end of song (speed decreases but points are still counted until two seconds after the last rune)
 Renamed “Haptics” settings into “Vibrations”
 Clicking on the parchment on the right of the throne displays Game Credits 
 Added a splash screen for fmod credits

notes.title: Development roadmap: where we are sailing to
notes.content:
Being able to offer an Early Access for Ragnaröck was important to us: it's a great way to develop a game with direct feedback from the players. Early Access is also a promise made to the community, it is a strong commitment between a studio and the players.

Since the release of Early Access, the entire team is very excited about the players' feedback on Ragnaröck. We have already rolled out quite a few updates, and we are working on a lot of new things at the same time, thanks to the community here, and on Twitter, Facebook, or Discord.

With this publication, we reveal where we want to go next:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/edf04df40c1e9557828ec8dba46eea891637da9c.jpg

Let's take a closer look at what that means:


Early Access is scheduled to end this summer. Until then, we want to roll out new features regularly. First of all to thank the players for their loyalty and their daily involvement in this Early Access, but also because we are eager to offer new things and extend the game!


 Each major update will bring new game content as well as features. There will be minor updates in between, if needed.
 Adding new environment maps is important for us: they immerse you on an epic journey, and also allow us to tell a story through different universes.
 The playlist of songs will be extended and we are in discussion with new bands every day. All of your recommendations are excellent and we are studying them with great interest!
 Comfort, personalization, replayability and competition features are the main components of future developments.
 The game will be translated into multiple languages ​​for the game's release.
 Regarding Oculus Quest compatibility, which many of you are asking about, we will do our best to do what is necessary during this year. The challenges are many, but we like it!


That's it for today! As usual, we are still hard at work so stay tuned. You are all invited to share reactions and areas of improvement here, or chat with the dev team on our Discord channel!

notes.title: Gameplay tips : learn how to combo !
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/e031fdb1acc2dc4a70989c1bdf05f72f2dd48467.jpg

From the first seconds in Ragnaröck, you immediately understand that you have to hit the drums to break the runes that come towards you in sync with the music. But what is not immediately obvious, is that a secondary mechanic allows you to increase your score and overtake your opponents: the use of streak bonuses, or "combos".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/218061602ff23aae0a1b51e850a52a2471fe357f.jpg

If you manage to hit rune after rune without going wrong, a combo gradually loads up along the handle of your hammers. When this gauge is full, the combo bonus becomes usable. Yes, when your hammers have a fully charged combo, you can strike on one of the shields at your side to send all that accumulated energy to your rowers and get a speed boost of a few seconds!

Tip #1

That’s not all! If you don't use your bonus right away, and continue to hit flawlessly, the combo will continue to charge a second gauge, this time on the hammerhead, until it reaches a second bonus level! The bonus generated when you reach this second step is four times more powerful and will give you a much greater speed boost!

Tip #2

A perfect hit on a rune (perfectly in the middle of the drum, so perfectly in sync with the music) is symbolized by golden lightning bolts on the drum when crushing the rune. You should know that perfect hits load your combo twice as fast as a regular hit!

Tip #3

Be careful, any mishit will drop the combo down to zero, and make you lose the bonus obtained if there was one. You will therefore have to calculate the risks and your chances of success!
For example, before a complicated series of notes, will you take the risk of continuing to increase your combo to level 2, or would you rather secure the level 1 bonus by using it right away?

What will be your strategy to optimize your score and overtake your opponents in the viking ship race?

notes.title: About the core gameplay
notes.content:
Vikings, and big epic music

In Ragnaröck, you play as a Viking ship captain determined to lead their crew to victory against their rivals. To finish the race in front of the others, you must motivate your rowers to give all their strength to move your boat forward. And all that, to the rhythm of epic music playing (here and here)!

Core gameplay

Since you are the leader of your boat, it's up to you to set the pace! You are equipped with hammers, ready to be struck with drive on the drums in front of you. The challenge ? Follow the rhythm of the luminous runes coming in! Achieving this throughout the song is the key to ensure unwavering support from your crew.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/d6d087e24d70d31c90238939d4c90aad9a576f8b.jpg

Crushing the runes on your drums with your hammers is good, but doing it perfectly in sync is better! The more precise you are, the faster your ship will move. Only your final score, representing the distance covered over the duration of the song, will be proof of your success.

Varied difficulty levels for more fun and challenge

Each track will have you playing different combinations and rhythms, as well as several levels of difficulty. The hardest ones may even make you lose your mind ... and your arms! And yet, you won't have the right to make mistakes, or you will risk losing your crew... and all of your speed.

notes.title: Art direction : about our work
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/26baee51e81370ea1cc346b191c743d674fcb838.jpg

In this article, we will detail our artistic approach regarding the environment that players will discover in Ragnaröck. It’s our art director for the Ragnaröck project, Suzanne, who talks about it best. First of all, let's take a quick look at her daily work :

[previewyoutube=BUsJUMepaX4;full][/previewyoutube]

Low Poly: an assumed graphic style

We decided to work on a style called “Low Poly”, both raw and pleasant, which we could, by shortcut, associate with a “cartoon” style.

This style is accessible and inviting. It insists on the “all ages” and playful side. It also allows you to distance yourself from reality. The representation is minimalist and simplified as much as possible, which helps bring clarity to the reading of a scene.

Thematic coherence and artistic impact

In Ragnaröck, we are situated in the Nordic and mythological universe, and we want players to be able to make this universe their own.

The evolution of the scenery as the game progresses tells an epic story. Several mythological elements are thus embedded in the first map of the game, such as gigantic monster skeletons, or Yggdrasil, the tree of nine worlds. The more the players fight to improve their score, the more they advance, and the more they reveal the universe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/37a1bb76843369909f5450a61df19c466f4af622.jpg

In this first map, the blue and purple colors were chosen to refer to the land of the cold, Niflheim. In contrast, the houses and everything that refers to the Viking world have warm colors: orange, red, brown (complementary color to blue).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/7a43161a8f79388e3a689535c92ba53f0491032b.jpg

Our way of working

The key concept is to set the general mood and the colors, and give the general direction to take.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/f79c55ae61a4fb9fe1b3ed00cf1e082c97f9e7ea.gif

Here, for example, we want players to start from a familiar landscape: the Viking village lost in a fjord, dominated by an austere environment. Subsequently, players discover several atmospheres, dominated by different luminosities.

Further work

We work on many elements of the game with this careful methodology, in order to respect a graphic and thematic consistency. Today we broached the subject of the environment, but we can also mention the characters, objects, gameplay elements… All these elements are currently being worked on, and will be visible when the game is released in Early Access, very soon.

notes.title: Multiplayer mode is coming soon !
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/d2257fe787f2a99d510dd88b109e4206f9c23d09.jpg

We are working very hard on the multiplayer mode for Ragnaröck right now, and we wanted to present this awesome feature to you.

Indeed, on top of the solo mode, you will also be able to play together from 2 to 8 players. In this online multiplayer PvP mode, everyone will lead their own viking ship, and compete in a side-by-side boat race.

All ships start aligned on the dock and set sail together when the song starts. The gameplay stays the same, meaning crushing the runes in sync with the music to go forward, and using the combo at the right time for speed boosts! And of course, the goal is to take your boat further than all the others thanks to your amazing skills!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/218061602ff23aae0a1b51e850a52a2471fe357f.jpg

Crush the runes, defeat your opponents!

During the race, the competition will be raging as you try to overtake your friends and finish on top of the scoreboard. Keep an eye on everyone else, but also don’t lose your concentration and keep hitting runes precisely, or others might pass you by.

You will be able to play with your friends on private servers or join a public server for a quick game. All compatible headsets can play together in Ragnaröck.

We can’t wait to release this cool multiplayer mode and see you guys have fun together (hopefully no friendship will be broken in the process XD )!
